name: dock
title: Dock
description: A row of launchers that swell toward the pointer.
use: A handful of places or tools, each shown by its picture or icon, that a reader returns to again and again: the apps of a desktop, the spaces of a workspace, the tools of a canvas. Each launcher carries its name as a label that shows under the pointer and the keys. The page places the dock, usually centered along the foot of a screen.

instead.when: The destinations of a small-screen app, each with a word under its icon, along the bottom edge
A row of quiet controls that act on what is selected
The main links of a site or an app, in words

keyboard.action: Move from one launcher to the next; the one with focus shows its label
Follow the link, or press the button

platform.feature: Neighbors read with :has() and the next-sibling combinator
platform.fallback: Supported in all current browsers; where :has() is missing, only the tile under the pointer and those after it grow
The tray is drawn in its own color, mostly opaque, without the blur
The tray and the tiles have circular corners

classes.name: dock
classes.description: The tray, a pane of frosted glass 56px tall, on a nav with an aria-label or a div with role="toolbar". Its tiles stand on its foot and grow over its top edge. It places nothing; the page decides where it stands

classes.name: dock-item
classes.description: A launcher: a link or a button, a 40px square raised tile holding an icon or a dock-image, with a dock-label for its name. Under a hovering pointer it grows by half, and its two neighbors on each side by less

classes.name: dock-image
classes.description: A picture that fills the tile, with an empty alt: the label names the launcher

classes.name: dock-label
classes.description: The launcher's name, in ink over the tile while it is under the pointer or has focus. It is also its accessible name, so it stays in the page while unseen

classes.name: dock-divider
classes.description: A short hairline between groups of launchers, with role="separator" and aria-orientation="vertical". The lens steps over it

states.name: current
states.description: On a link: a dot of ink under the tile

states.name: pressed
states.description: On a button that toggles something on, such as a panel: the same dot

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or aria-disabled="true" on a link: faded

properties.name: --dock-size
properties.description: A tile's side at rest; 2.75rem on a touch screen

properties.name: --dock-magnify
properties.description: How many times its size the tile under the pointer grows to; its neighbors grow by about a half and a sixth of that growth

properties.name: --dock-inset
properties.description: Space between the tiles and the tray's edge; the tray's corner is a tile's corner plus this inset

properties.name: --dock-color
properties.description: The color the glass is tinted with

example: Harbor Dunes
